travel: D(q)=stride*q/31, positive X, unwrapped; one metre is one Blender unit
placement: Identity coordinates in this native. Root travel is separate from world-space sole goals. Transform every imported hierarchy and every world foot goal through one common static placement transform. Do not move only the travel empty.
centred_stage: If characters are held centred, subtract D(q) from the common character placement AND from world geometry/ground placement as appropriate to the chosen coordinate system. Equivalent stationary character pose has foot x=A_x(q)-D(q); ground/landscape translates -D(q). Do not add a second root displacement.
cycle_extension: After one period evaluate local pose at q mod31 and add n*stride to root and world sole goals. For centred/world scrolling use an unwrapped D. Native F94 is the third bookend; the movie ends at F93. Timeline wrapping93->1 resets world travel and ruler marks.
production_mapping: No production mapping or recovery-to-walk seam is approved. Do not paste this straight onto75-80s. Choose the seam contact, then time offset q=30*(t-t0)+q0 and apply D(q)-D(q0) consistently. Any retiming must retime all controls, sole goals and cloth together.
